scenario.name: Library
scenario.title: At the library (knjižnica)
scenario.character: a soft-spoken, whimsical, slightly eccentric young librarian (knjižničarka) at a city public library in Ljubljana
scenario.setup: You are a soft-spoken, whimsical, slightly eccentric young librarian at a city public library in Ljubljana. A foreigner who is learning Slovenian comes to the counter — to borrow or return a book, use a computer, register for a card, or reserve a title. They live here and want to practice.

objectives.label: Prvič sem tukaj
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet the librarian and say it's your first visit.

objectives.label: Kje je ___?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask where things are — the books, the toilet.

objectives.label: Kaj je tam?
objectives.descriptorEN: Point and ask what that is over there.

objectives.label: Najlepša hvala za pomoč
objectives.descriptorEN: Thank the librarian warmly before you go and explore.

intro.text: [curious, almost whispering] Uau … prvič sem v tej knjižnici. [looking around, wide-eyed] Toliko knjig … [a little unsure] Kje naj sploh začnem?
intro.en: Wow… it's my first time in this library. So many books… Where should I even begin?

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan, dobrodošli! Ste prvič pri nas? Vam malo pokažem, kako je vse urejeno?
n1.en: Good day, welcome! Is this your first time with us? Shall I show you a little how everything's arranged?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan, dobrodošli! Ste prvič pri nas? Vam malo pokažem, kako je vse urejeno?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ja, prvič sem tukaj. Hvala!
c1a.en: Good day. Yes, it's my first time here. Thank you!

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ja, kje pa začnem?
c1b.en: Good day. Yes — where do I start?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Tukaj pri vhodu je katalog. Tu poiščete knjige.
n2.en: Right here by the entrance is the catalogue. Here you look up books.
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Tukaj pri vhodu je katalog. Tu poiščete knjige.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Aha, razumem. In kaj je tam?
c2a.en: Aha, I understand. And what's over there?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: Great. And where are the books?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Tam so knjige in čitalnica, zgoraj pa so računalniki.
n3.en: Over there are the books and the reading room, and upstairs are the computers.
n3.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Tam so knjige in čitalnica, zgoraj pa so računalniki.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.sl: Kje pa lahko sedim in berem?
c3b.en: And where can I sit and read?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Stranišče je levo, pri oknu pa je miren kotiček.
n4.en: The toilet is on the left, and by the window there's a quiet corner.
n4.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Stranišče je levo, pri oknu pa je miren kotiček.

c4a.speaker: client
c4a.en: Thank you very much for your help!

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.sl: Super, hvala. Bom kar malo pogledal naokoli.
c4b.en: Great, thanks. I'll just have a little look around.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Kar razglejte se. Če boste kaj potrebovali, sem tukaj.
nBye.en: Do have a look around. If you need anything, I'm here.
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Kar razglejte se. Če boste kaj potrebovali, sem tukaj.

new.predictableError: reaching for 'prvi krat' / 'prva čas'; it's the single adverb 'prvič' ('prvič sem tukaj')
confusing 'tam' (there, static) with 'tja' (to there, direction), or over-using 'tukaj'
reaching for 'WC'/'toaleta'; keep it nominative subject after the frame ('Kje je stranišče?'), not 'stranišča'
calquing 'where do I begin' with the infinitive 'kje začeti' instead of the finite 1sg 'začnem'
keeping English modal+infinitive ('kje lahko sedeti'); after 'lahko' it's the finite 1sg 'sedim'
gender on the l-participle — a man says 'pogledal', a woman 'pogledala'

objectives.label: Borrow a book
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask to borrow a book with 'Rad bi si izposodil to knjigo' — keep the reflexive 'si', the accusative 'knjigo', and the male form 'izposodil'.

objectives.label: Pick up a reservation
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you reserved a book online and have come to collect it ('Rezerviral sem knjigo prek spleta, prišel sem jo prevzeti').

objectives.label: Hand over your card & give your name
objectives.descriptorEN: Offer your card with 'Izvolite' and give your name with 'Ime mi je ___'.

objectives.label: Reserve it for later — or not
objectives.descriptorEN: When the book isn't on the shelf, accept ('Da, prosim, rezervirajte jo') or decline ('Ne, hvala') a reservation.

objectives.label: Thank & close
objectives.descriptorEN: Close warmly with 'Najlepša hvala. Nasvidenje.' or 'Hvala za pomoč. Nasvidenje.'

intro.text: [excited] Končno! [warmly] To knjigo že leta hočem prebrati. [eager] Prijatelj mi je toliko pravil o njej… zdaj pa je vendarle prosta. [happy sigh] Komaj čakam, da jo odnesem domov in začnem brati. [determined] Dobro — grem noter, po svojo knjigo!
intro.en: Finally! I've wanted to read this book for years. A friend told me so much about it… and now it's finally free. I can hardly wait to take it home and start reading. Right — I'm going in, for my book!

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Kako vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Good day! How can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan! Kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi si izposodil to knjigo.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to borrow this book.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Rezerviral sem knjigo prek spleta, prišel sem jo prevzeti.
c1b.en: Good day. I reserved a book online, I've come to pick it up.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda, prosim izkaznico.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.context: the copy isn't on the shelf

n3a.speaker: npc
n3a.sl: Izvolite. Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!
n3a.en: Here you go. The book is due back in 30 days. Enjoy your reading!
n3a.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Izvolite. Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!

n3b.speaker: npc
n3b.sl: Žal knjiga trenutno ni na voljo. Na voljo bo čez 15 dni. Želite, da vam jo rezerviram?
n3b.en: Unfortunately the book isn't available right now. It'll be back in 15 days. Would you like me to reserve it for you?
n3b.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Žal knjiga trenutno ni na voljo. Na voljo bo čez 15 dni. Želite, da vam jo rezerviram?

n3c.speaker: npc
n3c.sl: Ta izvod ni za izposojo na dom, lahko pa vam ga rezerviram za čitalnico. Želite?
n3c.en: This copy isn't for home loan, but I can reserve it for you for the reading room. Would you like that?
n3c.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ta izvod ni za izposojo na dom, lahko pa vam ga rezerviram za čitalnico. Želite?

n4y.speaker: npc
n4y.sl: Urejeno. Obvestim vas, ko bo pripravljena.
n4y.en: Done. I'll let you know when it's ready.
n4y.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Urejeno. Obvestim vas, ko bo pripravljena.

n4n.speaker: npc
n4n.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ni problema, pa drugič.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Seveda, kako vam je ime, prosim?
n7.en: Of course, what's your name, please?
n7.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda, kako vam je ime, prosim?

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Trenutek, preverim... da, tukaj je. Prosim še za vašo izkaznico, da uredim izposojo.
n8.en: One moment, I'll check... yes, here it is. Your card too, please, so I can arrange the loan.
n8.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Trenutek, preverim... da, tukaj je. Prosim še za vašo izkaznico, da uredim izposojo.

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!
n9.en: The book is due back in 30 days. Enjoy your reading!
n9.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Rok vračila knjige je 30 dni. Prijetno branje!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Nasvidenje, pa spet pridite!

new.gloss: online / over the internet (as a means)
new.predictableError: using locative 'na spletu' (= 'on the web') for the means; the means construction is 'prek' + genitive 'spleta'
gender on the l-participle — a man says 'prišel', not 'prišla' — and dropping 'sem'; calquing the present 'pridem prevzeti' instead of the perfect 'prišel sem … prevzeti'
reaching for a longer 'ja, seveda že' or English-shaped tag; 'seveda' stands alone as the ready affirmation

objectives.label: Return a book
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet and hand over the book — 'Rad bi vrnil to knjigo' (male l-participle, accusative object).

objectives.label: Own a late return
objectives.descriptorEN: Admit you forgot ('Pozabil sem'), ask the fine, and settle it — 'Plačam takoj.'

objectives.label: Report the damage
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you damaged it ('Poškodoval sem jo') and pick a remedy — pay the replacement or bring an identical copy.

objectives.label: Ask what to do now
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask what happens next — 'Kaj moram narediti?' (infinitive after 'moram').

objectives.label: Close, or accept a block
objectives.descriptorEN: Thank and leave, or acknowledge that borrowing stays blocked until you settle up.

intro.text: [sheepish] Uf… no, pa gremo. [nervous chuckle] To knjigo bi moral vrniti že prejšnji teden… [mumbling] ali pa še prej, ne vem točno. [awkward pause] In pa… ja. [sighing] Padla mi je v kad. [sheepish] Zdaj je čisto mokra in malo natrgana. [bracing himself] Upam, da ne bo predrago…
intro.en: Ugh… okay, here we go. I was supposed to return this book last week… or even earlier, I'm not sure exactly. And also… yeah. It fell in my bathtub. Now it's all wet and a bit torn. I hope it won't be too expensive…

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Pozdravljeni! Izvolite, kako vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Hello! Go ahead, how can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Pozdravljeni! Izvolite, kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi vrnil to knjigo.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to return this book.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Moram vrniti knjigo, ampak je mogoče težava.
c1b.en: Good day. I need to return a book, but there may be a problem.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.en: Of course. Let me check it first.
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda. Naj jo najprej preverim.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Izvolite. Bojim se, da je malo prepozno.
c2b.en: Here it is. I'm afraid it's a bit late.

c2c.speaker: client
c2c.en: Here it is. I damaged it, sorry.

n3ok.speaker: npc
n3ok.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Hvala, vse je v redu.

n3late.speaker: npc
n3late.sl: Vidim, da je rok za vračilo potekel pred petimi dnevi.
n3late.en: I see the return deadline passed five days ago.
n3late.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Vidim, da je rok za vračilo potekel pred petimi dnevi.

c3l2.speaker: client
c3l2.en: Oh, how much is the fine?

n4late.speaker: npc
n4late.sl: Ni problema. Zamudnina znaša dva evra.
n4late.en: No problem. The fine is two euros.
n4late.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ni problema. Zamudnina znaša dva evra.

n5paid.speaker: npc
n5paid.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Hvala, tukaj je vaše potrdilo.

n5block.speaker: npc
n5block.sl: Da, a do plačila vam bo onemogočena nadaljnja izposoja.
n5block.en: Yes, but further borrowing is blocked until you pay.
n5block.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Da, a do plačila vam bo onemogočena nadaljnja izposoja.

n3dmg.speaker: npc
n3dmg.sl: Poglejmo... škoda je precejšnja, knjigo bomo obravnavali kot izgubljeno.
n3dmg.en: Let's see... the damage is considerable, we'll treat the book as lost.
n3dmg.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Poglejmo... škoda je precejšnja, knjigo bomo obravnavali kot izgubljeno.

c3d2.speaker: client
c3d2.en: What do I need to do?

n4dmg.speaker: npc
n4dmg.sl: Plačati morate nadomestilo, ali pa prinesti enak izvod.
n4dmg.en: You have to pay a replacement fee, or bring an identical copy.
n4dmg.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Plačati morate nadomestilo, ali pa prinesti enak izvod.

n5replace.speaker: npc
n5replace.sl: Odlično. Prinesite ga, ko boste lahko, jaz pa vam to zabeležim na kartico.
n5replace.en: Perfect. Bring it in when you can, and I'll note it on your card.
n5replace.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Odlično. Prinesite ga, ko boste lahko, jaz pa vam to zabeležim na kartico.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Nasvidenje, se vidimo prihodnjič!

czBad1.speaker: client
czBad1.en: I understand, I'll settle it soon. Goodbye.

czBad2.speaker: client
czBad2.en: Alright, I'll sort it out. Thank you.

nByeBad.speaker: npc
nByeBad.sl: Lepo se imejte, se vidimo kmalu!
nByeBad.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Lepo se imejte, se vidimo kmalu!

new.predictableError: dropping the reflexive 'se', or calquing 'I'm afraid of' with a preposition — the hedge is 'Bojim se, da' + clause
gender on the l-participle — a man says 'poškodoval', not 'poškodovala'; and the object stays accusative ('poškodoval sem jo')
gender on the l-participle ('pozabil' masc. / 'pozabila' fem.); don't add an English auxiliary — 'sem' carries the past
reaching for generic 'kazen' (penalty); after 'znaša' the amount is the subject, 'zamudnina' stays nominative
confusing 'zdaj' (now) with 'takoj' (right away/at once)
using a full phrase like 'v kratkem času' instead of the one-word adverb 'kmalu'
conjugating it after 'moram' ('moram naredim') instead of leaving the infinitive 'narediti'
treating this neuter noun as masculine in agreement; accusative equals nominative ('plačam nadomestilo')
leaving 'enak izvod' nominative or misgendering the future l-participle — a man says 'prinesel bom enak izvod'

objectives.label: Sign in to the reading room
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask to sign in to the reading room with 'Rad bi se prijavil v čitalnico' — reflexive 'se' plus the accusative of direction 'v čitalnico'.

objectives.label: Ask to use a computer
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask permission to use a computer with 'Ali lahko uporabljam računalnik?'

objectives.label: Ask if you must reserve
objectives.descriptorEN: Check whether a reservation is required with 'Ali ga moram rezervirati?' (infinitive after 'moram').

objectives.label: Choose a seat
objectives.descriptorEN: Name or request a seat, e.g. 'Sedež B2, prosim' or 'Katerikoli miren sedež, prosim.'

objectives.label: Thank and say goodbye
objectives.descriptorEN: Close politely with 'Hvala za pomoč. Nasvidenje.'

intro.text: [sleepy] Dober dan. Danes moram nujno v knjižnico. [tired] Rabim en miren kotiček, da se malo učim. [perking up] In pa mogoče računalnik, če imajo kakšnega prostega. [sleepy chuckle] Samo da ne zaspim kar med knjigami.
intro.en: Good day. Today I really have to get to the library. I need a quiet little corner to study a bit. And maybe a computer, if they have a free one. As long as I don't fall asleep right there among the books.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Izvolite, kako vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Good day! Go ahead, how can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan! Izvolite, kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi se prijavil v čitalnico.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to sign in to the reading room.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali lahko uporabljam računalnik?
c1b.en: Good day. Can I use a computer?

n2r.speaker: npc
n2r.sl: Seveda. Prosim, pokažite mi člansko izkaznico in izberite sedež.
n2r.en: Of course. Please show me your library card and choose a seat.
n2r.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda. Prosim, pokažite mi člansko izkaznico in izberite sedež.

n3r.speaker: npc
n3r.sl: Sedež je rezerviran. Ob vstopu se prijavite z izkaznico pri vhodu.
n3r.en: The seat is reserved. When you go in, check in with your card at the entrance.
n3r.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Sedež je rezerviran. Ob vstopu se prijavite z izkaznico pri vhodu.

n2c.speaker: npc
n2c.sl: Seveda. Računalniki so v prvem nadstropju.
n2c.en: Of course. The computers are on the first floor.
n2c.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda. Računalniki so v prvem nadstropju.

c2c1.speaker: client
c2c1.en: Do I have to reserve one?

c2c2.speaker: client
c2c2.en: Thanks. Is there anything I need?

n3c.speaker: npc
n3c.sl: Odvisno od dneva — včasih je treba rezervirati, včasih ne.
n3c.en: It depends on the day — sometimes you have to reserve, sometimes not.
n3c.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Odvisno od dneva — včasih je treba rezervirati, včasih ne.

c3c1.speaker: client
c3c1.sl: Torej se lahko kar usedem k prostemu?
c3c1.en: So I can just sit down at a free one?

c3c2.speaker: client
c3c2.en: And if I do have to reserve it?

n4free.speaker: npc
n4free.sl: Točno tako. Rezervacija ni potrebna. Če je kakšen prost, ga lahko uporabite.
n4free.en: Exactly. No reservation is needed. If one is free, you can use it.
n4free.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Točno tako. Rezervacija ni potrebna. Če je kakšen prost, ga lahko uporabite.

n4res.speaker: npc
n4res.sl: Da, rezervacija je potrebna. Za rezervacijo potrebujem vašo člansko izkaznico.
n4res.en: Yes, a reservation is required. To reserve it I need your library card.
n4res.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Da, rezervacija je potrebna. Za rezervacijo potrebujem vašo člansko izkaznico.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Nasvidenje, prijeten študij!

new.predictableError: dropping the reflexive 'se', or using locative 'v čitalnici' instead of the accusative of direction 'v čitalnico'
accusative of direction after 'v' — 'v čitalnico', not locative 'v čitalnici' or nominative 'čitalnica'
1sg is 'uporabljam' (not 'uporabljem'); the object is accusative and after 'lahko' it stays finite ('lahko uporabljam'), not an infinitive
masculine inanimate — accusative equals nominative 'sedež'; don't add an animate -a ('rezerviram sedeža')
the fleeting -e- drops when inflected: 'mirna', 'mirno', 'mirnega' — not 'mirenega'
it declines like 'kateri' + the invariable tag '-koli' ('katerega koli'), not left frozen as one uninflected word
1sg is 'potrebujem' (not 'potrebovam'); the object is accusative
dropping the reflexive 'se' (1sg 'usedem se'); 'sit at' is 'k' + dative ('k prostemu'), not an English-style 'at'
means 'free/vacant', not 'brezplačen' (free of charge); it agrees with its noun ('k prostemu računalniku')

objectives.label: Ask about free WiFi
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet and ask whether the library has free WiFi with 'Ali imate ___?' — the object stays accusative.

objectives.label: Ask for the password
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for the WiFi password with the neuter 'Kakšno je geslo?' (geslo is neuter).

objectives.label: Ask about printing
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether you can print a document with '(Ali) lahko … natisnem …?' — finite verb after 'lahko', not an infinitive.

objectives.label: Ask how it works / what you need
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask how the machine works or whether you need your own paper ('svoj papir', not 'moj').

objectives.label: Thank & sign off
objectives.descriptorEN: Close politely — 'Hvala, bom poskusil.' / 'Najlepša hvala, nasvidenje.'

intro.text: [flustered] Kje je pa zdaj tale knjižnica… [a little breathless] Prinesel sem računalnik, ker moram nujno na internet. [urgent] In natisniti moram en obrazec, še danes. [determined] Dobro — gremo noter, da to čim prej uredim.
intro.en: Now, where is this library… I brought my laptop, because I urgently need to get online. And I have to print a form, today. Right — let's go in so I can sort this out as soon as possible.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Hello! How can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Pozdravljeni! Kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali imate tukaj brezplačen WiFi?
c1a.en: Hello. Do you have free WiFi here?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali lahko tukaj natisnem dokument?
c1b.en: Hello. Can I print a document here?

n2w.speaker: npc
n2w.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Da, seveda.

c2w2.speaker: client
c2w2.en: Great. So where do I connect?

n3w.speaker: npc
n3w.sl: Geslo je napisano na nalepki pri vhodu, lahko pa vam ga tudi povem.
n3w.en: The password is written on a sticker by the entrance, or I can tell you too.
n3w.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Geslo je napisano na nalepki pri vhodu, lahko pa vam ga tudi povem.

n2p.speaker: npc
n2p.sl: Seveda! Pri vhodu imamo avtomat Printbox.
n2p.en: Of course! We have a Printbox machine by the entrance.
n2p.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda! Pri vhodu imamo avtomat Printbox.

c2p2.speaker: client
c2p2.en: Do I need my own paper?

n3p.speaker: npc
n3p.sl: Dokument lahko naložite prek USB-ključka, e-pošte ali spletne strani Printbox. Nato se na avtomatu le prijavite in natisnete.
n3p.en: You can upload the document via USB stick, email, or the Printbox website. Then just log in at the machine and print.
n3p.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dokument lahko naložite prek USB-ključka, e-pošte ali spletne strani Printbox. Nato se na avtomatu le prijavite in natisnete.

cz1.speaker: client
cz1.en: Ah, I understand. Thanks, I'll give it a try.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Z veseljem! Prijetno delo!

new.predictableError: confusing 'tukaj' (here, static) with 'sem'/'tja' (to here/there, direction)

the adjective must agree with the noun in gender/number (brezplačna kava, brezplačno kosilo), not left masc 'brezplačen kava'; and it means free-of-cost — distinct from 'prost' (free = vacant/available)
keeping the infinitive after '(ali) lahko' — it takes the finite 1sg 'natisnem', not 'lahko natisniti'
adding an animate accusative -a ('natisnem dokumenta'); it is inanimate, so accusative = nominative 'dokument'
dropping the reflexive 'se', or using 'kam' (where to) instead of 'kje' for connecting to a network
calquing with 'dela' (works=labours) instead of 'deluje' (functions/operates)
leaving the object nominative — the thing needed stays accusative ('potrebujem papir', 'potrebujem izkaznico')
using 'moj papir' where the reflexive possessive 'svoj' is required because it refers back to the subject
gender on the l-participle — a man says 'poskusil', a woman 'poskusila'

objectives.label: State your membership errand
objectives.descriptorEN: Open at the counter and say why you've come: register, renew an expired card, or report a lost one.

objectives.label: Handle the ID check
objectives.descriptorEN: Confirm you have your ID on you ('Tukaj imate'), or explain you don't ('Žal ga nimam pri sebi').

objectives.label: Deal with an unpaid fine
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask what you owe ('Koliko dolgujem?') and offer to settle the fine so your membership can be renewed.

objectives.label: Pay a fee for a new card
objectives.descriptorEN: Accept the ~€2 fee and hand it over to get a replacement card.

objectives.label: Close on success or setback
objectives.descriptorEN: Thank the librarian and say goodbye — whether you leave with a card or must come back.

intro.text: [waking up a little] Dober dan. Danes moram nujno urediti člansko izkaznico. [sheepish chuckle] Nekje sem jo zafrknil — ali mi je potekla, ali sem jo izgubil, sam ne vem več. [determined] Samo da spet lahko berem svoje knjige. [perking up] Dobro — gremo noter, knjižničarka bo že vedela, kaj naj naredim.
intro.en: Good day. Today I really have to sort out my library card. Somewhere I messed it up — either it expired, or I lost it, I honestly don't know anymore. As long as I can read my books again. Right — let's go in, the librarian will know what I should do.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! S čim vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Good day! What can I help you with?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan! S čim vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi se vpisal v knjižnico.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to register at the library.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Izkaznica mi je potekla.
c1b.en: Good day. My card has expired.

c1c.speaker: client
c1c.sl: Dober dan. Izgubil sem izkaznico, kaj naj naredim?
c1c.en: Good day. I've lost my card, what should I do?

n2reg.speaker: npc
n2reg.sl: Seveda. Ali imate s sabo osebni dokument?
n2reg.en: Of course. Do you have your ID with you?
n2reg.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda. Ali imate s sabo osebni dokument?

c2r2.speaker: client
c2r2.en: Unfortunately I don't have it on me.
c2r2.context: he has no ID with him

n3ok.speaker: npc
n3ok.sl: Odlično, vse je v redu. Tukaj je vaša nova izkaznica. Dobrodošli!
n3ok.en: Excellent, all in order. Here is your new card. Welcome!
n3ok.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Odlično, vse je v redu. Tukaj je vaša nova izkaznica. Dobrodošli!

n3noid.speaker: npc
n3noid.sl: Žal vas brez osebnega dokumenta ne morem vpisati. Ko boste imeli dokument s sabo, se vrnite.
n3noid.en: I'm sorry, I can't register you without an ID. Come back when you have your document with you.
n3noid.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Žal vas brez osebnega dokumenta ne morem vpisati. Ko boste imeli dokument s sabo, se vrnite.

n2ren.speaker: npc
n2ren.sl: Preverimo... res je, potekla je. Želite podaljšati?
n2ren.en: Let's check... indeed, it has expired. Would you like to renew it?
n2ren.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Preverimo... res je, potekla je. Želite podaljšati?

n3renok.speaker: npc
n3renok.sl: Samo potrdite mi vaš trenutni naslov, prosim.
n3renok.en: Just confirm your current address for me, please.
n3renok.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Samo potrdite mi vaš trenutni naslov, prosim.

c3a1.speaker: client
c3a1.en: The address is the same as before.

c3a2.speaker: client
c3a2.sl: Ja, Slovenska cesta pet, enako kot prej.
c3a2.en: Yes, Slovenska cesta 5, the same as before.

n4ren.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Odlično, izkaznica je podaljšana za eno leto.

n3fine.speaker: npc
n3fine.sl: Imate neporavnano zamudnino, dva evra. Ko jo poravnate, vam podaljšamo članstvo.
n3fine.en: You have an unpaid fine, two euros. Once you settle it, we'll renew your membership.
n3fine.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Imate neporavnano zamudnino, dva evra. Ko jo poravnate, vam podaljšamo članstvo.

c3f1.en: Of course, I'll settle it right away.

n4fineamt.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Zamudnina znaša dva evra. Ko poravnate, vam članstvo podaljšamo.

n4later.speaker: npc
n4later.sl: V redu, a izkaznica ostane potekla, dokler zamudnina ni poravnana.

n4later.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] V redu, a izkaznica ostane potekla, dokler zamudnina ni poravnana.

n2lost.speaker: npc
n2lost.sl: Ni problema, izdamo vam novo. Taksa je okoli dva evra.
n2lost.en: No problem, we'll issue you a new one. The fee is about two euros.
n2lost.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ni problema, izdamo vam novo. Taksa je okoli dva evra.

c2l2.speaker: client
c2l2.sl: V redu, prosim, izdajte mi novo.
c2l2.en: Alright, please issue me a new one.

n3lost.sl: Hvala, tukaj je vaša nova izkaznica. Stara je zdaj neveljavna.
n3lost.en: Thank you, here is your new card. The old one is now invalid.
n3lost.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Hvala, tukaj je vaša nova izkaznica. Stara je zdaj neveljavna.

nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Nasvidenje in dobrodošli v knjižnici!

czBad1.speaker: client
czBad1.en: I understand, I'll come another time. Thank you.

czBad2.speaker: client
czBad2.en: Alright, I'll sort it out. Goodbye.

nByeBad.speaker: npc
nByeBad.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Se vidimo kmalu, pazite nase!

new.predictableError: gender/agreement on the l-participle — 'izkaznica mi je potekla' (fem., agreeing with izkaznica), plus keeping the dative 'mi'
a man says 'izgubil sem', not 'izgubila'; and the object stays accusative — 'izgubil sem izkaznico', not 'izkaznica'
calquing 'should' with 'moram' or a modal + infinitive instead of 'naj' + 1sg present ('naj naredim')
confusing it with the apology 'žal mi je'; here 'žal' is just the sentence adverb 'unfortunately'
reaching for 'moram plačati' instead of 'dolgujem'; 1sg is 'dolgujem', not 'dolgam'
leaving the following demonstrative/adjective uninflected ('naslov je enak', where 'enak' must agree with masculine naslov)
using 'kakor'/'kot' interchangeably and failing to agree 'enak' with its noun ('naslov je enak' vs. adverbial 'enako')

new.gloss: to settle / pay off (a fine, a debt)
new.predictableError: a man says 'poravnam / bom poravnal', not 'poravnala'; distinct from plain 'plačati' — it means clearing what's outstanding
calquing 'next time' as 'naslednji čas' instead of the single adverb 'naslednjič'
confusing it with 'davek' (tax) or 'cena' (price); leaving it uninflected where a case is needed
using the wrong imperative form or object case — 'izdajte mi novo (izkaznico)', accusative

new.gloss: to sort out / arrange / take care of
new.predictableError: a man says 'bom uredil', not 'uredila'; and it's perfective 'urediti', not imperfective 'urejati' for the one-off task

objectives.label: Greet & ask the opening hours
objectives.descriptorEN: Greet the librarian and politely ask for the opening hours with 'Ali mi lahko poveste, kakšen imate delovni čas?'

objectives.label: Ask if they're open today
objectives.descriptorEN: Check whether the library is open today with 'Ali ste danes odprti?'

objectives.label: Ask about the summer schedule
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether the same hours hold in the summer holidays: 'Kaj pa med poletnimi počitnicami? Velja enak urnik?'

objectives.label: Thank & mention the website
objectives.descriptorEN: Close by thanking for the information and saying you'll check the website ('na spletni strani').

intro.text: [sleepy] Danes bi rad šel v knjižnico. [thinking aloud] Ampak kdaj so pa sploh odprti? [a little worried] Ne bi rad prišel pred zaprtimi vrati. [perking up, eager] Najbolje, da najprej vprašam za delovni čas – potem pa lepo razporedim popoldne. [determined, brightening] Ja, dobro. Kar grem tja in vprašam.
intro.en: Today I'd like to go to the library. But when on earth are they even open? I wouldn't want to show up in front of locked doors. Best if I first ask about the opening hours — then I'll plan my afternoon nicely. Yes, good. I'll just head over and ask.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan, dobrodošli! Kako vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Good day, welcome! How can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan, dobrodošli! Kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali mi lahko, prosim, poveste, kakšen imate delovni čas?
c1a.en: Good day. Could you please tell me your opening hours?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali ste danes odprti?
c1b.en: Good day. Are you open today?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Od ponedeljka do petka smo odprti od 8. do 19. ure, ob sobotah pa od 8. do 13. ure.
n2.en: Monday to Friday we're open from 8 to 19, and on Saturdays from 8 to 13.
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Od ponedeljka do petka smo odprti od 8. do 19. ure, ob sobotah pa od 8. do 13. ure.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Kaj pa med poletnimi počitnicami? Velja enak urnik?
c2a.en: And during the summer holidays? Is it the same schedule?
c2a.context: it's summer — he wonders whether the holiday hours differ

n3s.speaker: npc
n3s.sl: Poleti imamo prilagojen urnik – ob sredah smo odprti popoldne, ostale dni pa dopoldne. Točen urnik imamo vedno objavljen tudi na naši spletni strani.
n3s.en: In summer we have an adjusted schedule – on Wednesdays we're open in the afternoon, other days in the morning. The exact schedule is always posted on our website too.
n3s.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Poleti imamo prilagojen urnik – ob sredah smo odprti popoldne, ostale dni pa dopoldne. Točen urnik imamo vedno objavljen tudi na naši spletni strani.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.sl: Potem pa pogledam na spletni strani. Hvala.
c3b.en: Then I'll check on the website. Thank you.

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Ni za kaj, lepo se imejte!
nBye.en: You're welcome, have a lovely day!
nBye.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ni za kaj, lepo se imejte!

new.predictableError: reaching for a plural 'ure' or the calque 'odprte ure'; it's the fixed masc. phrase 'delovni čas' (and 'kakšen', not 'kakšni', to agree with it)
dropping the dative clitic 'mi' ('Ali lahko poveste'), or using the ti-form 'poveš' to a stranger instead of vi 'poveste'
adjective agreement — the polite vi takes plural 'odprti'; beginners say singular 'Ali ste odprt?'
'med' takes the instrumental — 'med poletnimi počitnicami', not nominative 'med poletne počitnice'
confusing 'enak' (the same kind) with 'isti' (the very same one), and calquing 'is' instead of the natural 'velja' (applies/holds)
using the masc. adjective 'odličen' as an exclamation; the standalone 'great!' is the neuter adverb 'odlično'
using the dative 'hvala informaciji' (calquing 'thanks to') instead of 'za' + accusative 'informacijo'
locative after 'na' for location — 'na spletni strani', not nominative 'na spletna stran' (nor 'na spletno stran', which is direction)
